# Zacito

> Portfolio, photography, code, and AI resources by Zacito (Mankato, Minnesota).

## Pages

- [Home](https://zacito.github.io/): Link hub — blog, AI resources, and creative profiles.
- [AI](https://zacito.github.io/ai/): Curated AI links. Models and assistants: ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, DeepSeek, Gemini, GLM (Z.ai), Grok, Kimi, Mistral, Muse, Qwen. Agents: AutoGPT, Cline, CrewAI, Devin, Hermes Agent, LangGraph, Letta, Manus, OpenClaw, OpenHands. Platforms: Hugging Face, OpenRouter. News: The Neuron, TLDR AI, The Rundown AI.
- [AI 101](https://zacito.github.io/ai/101/): A plain-language introduction to artificial intelligence — what AI is, what it can do, and how large language models work. Includes links to the "Attention Is All You Need" paper and Andrej Karpathy's 3-hour "Deep Dive into LLMs like ChatGPT" video.
- [AI Definitions](https://zacito.github.io/ai/definitions/): Plain-language definitions of AI terms and acronyms (LLM, agent, RAG, token, MCP, hallucination, fine-tuning, and more), three sentences each. Also published as schema.org DefinedTermSet structured data in the page.
- [Blog](https://zacito.github.io/blog/): Blog by Zacito.
- [Coder](https://zacito.github.io/coder/): Browser code playground — write HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and see the result live.
- [NFL](https://zacito.github.io/nfl/): NFL links — fantasy football, scores, standings, and depth charts.
- [Shows](https://zacito.github.io/shows/): Fall TV show tracker.
